messages:
maria_mkt: Quick recap from today's call with QuantaEdge. They gave a short line we can use in the case header: "Redwood made our inference pipeline predictable and cheaper at scale." Need legal review, comms approval, and to decide routing for webinar signups.

kevin_growth: Nice. Can you paste verbatim and attach the 20s audio? I'll cut a 10s promo for paid socials.

maria_mkt: Verbatim: "Redwood made our inference pipeline predictable and cheaper at scale, which let us ship features faster." Uploading clip now.

nina_legal: Heads-up: wording looks OK but avoid comparative language about competitors. Also prefer "reduced unit costs" vs "cheaper". Suggest: "Redwood made our inference pipeline more predictable and reduced per-inference costs at scale." Confirm with their comms and attach the signed release.

leo_cs: They signed our standard advocacy release. I'll ping their comms lead for the softened wording and exact attribution (name + title). Also asked that we link to their public demo repo.

kevin_growth: For the webinar form routing: map fields email, company, role, use_case, interest_tier. High-intent (use_case includes "benchmark" or "cost") should route to AE queue. Devops-bot, can you remind us of publish checklist?

devops-bot: Reminder: marketing publish checklist: signed release attached, comms approval captured, SFDC campaign created, CDN assets uploaded, tracking tags present.

maria_mkt: QuantaEdge comms approved the revised quote and provided attribution: "Priya Nair, Head of ML, QuantaEdge". No embargo. They've approved the audio snippet for a 15s teaser but asked we keep technical specifics high level.

kevin_growth: Great. I'll create two headline variants for A/B testing and set paid promos to run after publish. Maria, can you confirm landing CTA? Options: "Read the case + register" or "See the demo + join webinar".

maria_mkt: Leaning to "See the demo + join webinar" to capture both demo-seekers and webinar folks. Landing draft uploaded to Google Drive. Please review.

nina_legal: Legal sign-off complete once release is attached to the CMS entry and attribution matches the provided string exactly.

leo_cs: Release uploaded to Box at box.com/redwood/quanta-release.pdf. SFDC campaign will be created after creative is finalized.

kevin_growth: I'll queue the A/B headlines and paid audience. Timeline: publish post + open registration Wednesday 09:00 PT, paid promos Wednesday afternoon, webinar next Tuesday 11:00 PT. Speaker prep call scheduled day before.

maria_mkt: All attachments added and quote block updated to legal wording. Marking this thread resolved. Thanks :tada:
